feature: Light, dark and system appearance preference
behavior: Accessible native theme picker in topbar: Sistem, Terang, Gelap.
Default follows device; live system changes affect only the system preference.
Explicit selection persists and synchronizes across tabs using uangku:theme:v1.
Early head bootstrap applies resolved appearance before React mounts.
Blocked persistence retains session appearance and reports inability to remember the choice.
Financial ledger and currency/lastWallets preference keys are untouched by appearance changes.
covered: Startup, reload, live media changes, native keyboard selection, real second-tab events.
Invalid preferences and simulated theme-only/all-storage read and write errors.
Light/dark at viewport widths320,390,1440; all four navigation pages.
Ordinary entry, FX entry/validation, amount/transfer read-only details, privacy dialog.
Exact v1/v2 financial bytes, currency/lastWallets bytes and v2 backup object preservation.
limits: Windows Chromium automation with mobile emulation; no physical iOS/Android or manual screen-reader verification.
Contrast samples cover visible solid text/control/placeholder states after finite transitions settle; gradients and disabled controls excluded.
Startup attribute/frame observations are not a pixel-level filmstrip guarantee.
Full source lifecycle, backfill, quota/capacity and performance browser suites were not repeated for this appearance change; prior evidence remains historical.
Remote CI now includes the theme gate in configuration but was not executed remotely.

test_harness_corrections.description: Initial visual checks selected a hidden mobile privacy button and sampled transient button color transitions. Corrected harness uses visible privacy control and waits for finite transitions; startup observation unchanged. Both attempts retained.

archive_decision: New combined packaging and off-PC backup deferred by user; old snapshots retained.
